title: Platform secret-store result and availability state
description: The result of one typed secret-store operation plus the store's explicit availability and permission state. Secret bytes, passphrases, recovered values, and derived key material can never appear here, in diagnostics, or in an evidence bundle; a retrieval reports only an opaque reference and a digest. There is no plaintext, file, or environment-variable fallback state.

store_availability.description: Explicit availability and permission state of the platform secure store itself.

store_identity_token.description: Bounded identity of the native store family that answered, without naming a service, account, registry location, or bus address.

material_reference.description: Opaque handle returned for a successful retrieval or storage. It is not the secret.
